name: 1% Salicylic Acid Face Wash (Foam-Based)
subtitle: For Mild Occasional Acne | Dry/Combination Skin Type | Suitable for 13+ yrs
usageInstructions: Use the anti acne wash twice a day, morning & evening. Pump out a coin size, work up a mild lather and massage your face in gentle, anti-clockwise circular movements for 60 seconds. Rinse with lukewarm or tap water and pat dry your face with a clean towel.
